description: KS federal QSS = Kansas HOH per the booklet ('check the Head of Household box'), and the form's HOH box carries the $2,320 additional exemption: $9,160 + $2,320 + 1 dependent $2,320 = $13,800 (not $18,320 joint). DELIBERATE: K.S.A. 79-32,121b(b)(1) speaks of 'head of household, as defined in 26 U.S.C. § 2(b)'; the pack follows the form and discloses.
